scenarios.precondition: Notification consumer is processing an isolated test queue.
scenarios.observation: Queue depth grows; replay remains inbox-idempotent after restart.
scenarios.recovery: Restart the exact Notification process and verify its readiness endpoint.

scenarios.precondition: Search profile is healthy and test events are identifiable.
scenarios.observation: Resource writes remain available and Search reports explicit unavailability.
scenarios.recovery: docker compose --profile search start elasticsearch; verify cluster health.

scenarios.precondition: Two isolated Resource instances are registered in Nacos.
scenarios.observation: The stopped instance is removed and bounded reads use the remaining instance.
scenarios.recovery: Restart only Resource instance 2 and verify readiness plus Nacos registration.

scenarios.precondition: The isolated Resource HTTP fixture supports a bounded delay.
scenarios.observation: Feign times out inside Booking and no write is reported as successful.
scenarios.recovery: Remove fixture delay and verify one bounded Booking request.

scenarios.precondition: A synthetic eventId is reserved for the isolated test.
scenarios.observation: Two deliveries create one inbox-owned business effect.
scenarios.recovery: Purge only the synthetic fixture message and retain the inbox evidence.

scenarios.precondition: Booking and its publisher run as separately controllable test processes.
scenarios.observation: Committed Outbox rows remain pending and publish after restart.
scenarios.recovery: Restart only the Outbox publisher and verify bounded backlog convergence.

scenarios.precondition: Resource cache profile is healthy with disposable test keys.
scenarios.observation: Resource detail falls through to MySQL without false not-found.
scenarios.recovery: docker compose --profile base start redis; verify PONG and cache refill.
